run_att_maps_recombine: run the script to filter and recombine attention maps by translation direction and sequence length
run_main_function: run main with source directory, laser directory, attention maps directory, and output file path
filter_attention_maps_by_laser: filter attention maps by LASER similarity, length ratio, and loss using quantile thresholds
group_attmaps_by_direction: group translation files by language direction and load corresponding LASER scores and attention maps
pickle_filtered_attmaps: pickle filtered attention maps grouped by translation direction and sequence length to output file
